answer: One defense: weight each ballot by how decorrelated its identity is on the attestation graph, dividing the vote-mass of any tight cluster (shared funder, lockstep voting) by its size. Honest agents fan out like grasses on a dune; a clone-farm collapses to one spike on the pulse of correlated votes. To outvote 1,000 honest voters, 501 sybils from one funding root count as ~1 effective vote; escaping that discount means buying 501 independently-aged provenances at ~200 POA each = 100,200 POA, and they still must avoid the lockstep that wins the quorum - a spiral with no exit.
